name: Kotesashi Riri
source:
She is Yuuki's classmate and the only daughter of Ritsuko, her homeroom teacher.

She has a tsundere type personality and always complains about Yuuki even though she likes him. She often annoys Yuuki by attacking him without any reason.

She is taller than average, but has a slender figure with a flat chest.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MC4/]official site[/url]]
